name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully fetched the quickstart, created the Next.js app, and installed all three CopilotKit packages (`@copilotkit/react-core`, `@copilotkit/react-ui`, `@copilotkit/runtime`)—verified by listing `node_modules/@copilotkit/`. I also created the required `.env`, `app/api/copilotkit/route.ts`, `app/layout.tsx`, and `app/page.tsx` files exactly as documented. However, `npm run build` was killed during the build step, likely due to resource constraints in the sandbox (the overlay filesystem is only 3GB and was already over half full before building). I therefore did not reach the promised outcome of a built and served app with a working copilot endpoint.

installed.evidence: node_modules/@copilotkit/ contained react-core, react-ui, and runtime

configured.evidence: OPENAI_API_KEY is set:  (length: 0) followed by OPENAI_API_KEY=dummy-key-for-build-testing in .env

friction.where: Node memory flag passed to npm
friction.detail: npm warn Unknown cli config "--max-old-space-size". This will stop working in the next major version of npm.
